status: Proposed in Phase 1, to be wired into src/app/globals.css (Tailwind @theme) in Phase 2.
direction: Soft warm neutrals taken from the clinic itself (cream walls, oak cabinets, stone floor) with one accent: the honey gold of her logo, which also matches the oak in the reception. No clinical blue.

accent.name: honey gold
accent.use: primary buttons (with espresso text), stars, icons, rules. Never as text on light backgrounds.

accentStrong.name: bronze
accentStrong.use: links, small accent text, focus ring

gradient.use: decorative only (logo mark, thin rules), from the logo's own stops

contrast.note: WCAG 2.1 contrast ratios. All text pairs pass AA (4.5:1). Gold on cream is 2.25:1, so gold is decorative only on light backgrounds.

typography.proposal: A soft serif for headings to echo the script logo without copying it (Fraunces), and a warm, very readable sans for body (DM Sans), both via next/font/google.
typography.headings: Fraunces, weights 400 to 600, optical size on
typography.body: DM Sans, weights 400 and 500, 17px base on desktop, 16px on mobile, line-height 1.65
